[IDAT.3.3.1] `ds_json_t` is opaque ([IDAT.1.2]): integrators
inspect and build trees only through the accessor / builder API in
`libds.h`, never by field-walking the layout. The full signatures
live in the header (the header is the ABI); their normative
contract is [IDAT.3.3.2]–[IDAT.3.3.12]. libds's own modules — and
white-box impl tests ([ITST]) — may include `internal/json.h` and
field-walk directly; nothing reachable from `libds.h` alone may.
